records.title: DepCache: A KV Cache Management Framework for GraphRAG with Dependency Attention
records.reason: Official SIGMOD 2026 accepted-paper list confirms title/authors, but ACM DOI page was inaccessible (HTTP 403), so no primary abstract was available to assess its KV-cache method. Retain as borderline with DOI/title and exact retrieval failure.

records.title: Dealing with the Elephant in the KV Cache: Video Frame Sampling for Multimodal LLM Inference
records.reason: Official EuroMLSys program confirms title/authors but contains no abstract for this item. ACM DOI page was inaccessible (HTTP 403), leaving only a title-level inference-efficiency lead.

records.title: Prefilling-dLLM: Predictive Prefilling for Long-Context Inference in Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: The abstract describes chunked KV-prefill reuse and sparse selection for diffusion LLMs, reducing per-step cost and reporting 9.1–28.0× speedups at 8K–32K contexts. This directly targets long-context inference latency and memory.

records.title: Preserving Provenance in Shared KV Caches for LLM Serving
records.reason: The abstract studies shared KV-cache correctness across adapters, weights, and sharing domains, then proposes provenance-bound keys and a differential checker. It eliminates unsafe reuse while preserving legitimate sharing with low hit-path latency impact.

records.title: BlockDialect: Block-wise Fine-grained Mixed Format Quantization for Energy-Efficient LLM Inference
records.reason: The abstract proposes per-block mixed-format/FP4 quantization and online activation quantization for LLM inference, with lower bit usage and accuracy close to full precision. Its stated target is energy-efficient inference.

records.title: CaR: An Efficient KV Cache Reuse System for Large Language Model Inference
records.reason: The primary paper abstract describes multi-tier KV reuse using CXL, GPU–CXL transfer, co-designed scheduling/cache management, pipelined prefetch, and KV sparsification. It reports lower TTFT, directly addressing serving memory and latency. The candidate title exactly matches the author-hosted primary paper title.

records.title: DeepEdu-v1: Efficient and Scalable Agentic LLMs for Vietnamese Education
records.reason: Though evaluated in an education application, the abstract explicitly presents a reusable long-context LLM inference engine that reduces retrieval calls, cuts prefill latency about 35%, and nearly doubles TTFT speed over standard vLLM. The concrete inference-system contribution supports inclusion.

records.title: AdaMTP: An Adaptive Training Paradigm for Multi-Token Prediction
records.reason: The abstract explains adaptive prediction horizons for multi-token prediction and reports better inference speedup than standard MTP across multiple backbones. Despite being a training method, it explicitly targets faster inference.

records.title: CSAttention: Centroid-Scoring Attention for Accelerating LLM Inference
records.reason: The abstract introduces training-free sparse attention for reusable long-context prompts, with precomputed query-centric tables and high-sparsity decoding. It reports up to 4.6× inference speedup at 128K context with near-full-attention accuracy.

records.title: Challenging Quadratic Attention - A Holistic View On the Rise of Alternative Language Model Architectures
records.reason: The official ACL Anthology record exactly matches the candidate title and reviews subquadratic attention, recurrent networks, state-space models, and hybrids in compute/memory terms, including edge-device contexts. This is a direct survey of efficient sequence architectures.

records.title: Memory-Efficient KV Cache Optimization for Large Language Model Inference at the Edge
records.reason: The official IEEE abstract proposes LiteKV for edge LLM inference and reports up to 75% less KV-cache memory while preserving comparable quality and 95% decoding efficiency. It directly addresses constrained inference memory/latency.

records.title: VFA: Relieving Vector Operations in Flash Attention with Global Maximum Pre-computation
records.reason: The abstract identifies online-softmax reductions/rescaling as vector-limited attention-kernel costs, then proposes VFA/VSA traversal and maximum-update changes to reduce overhead without performance loss. This directly targets attention-kernel latency.

records.title: G²PTQ: Improving LLM Post-Training Quantization with Generalized Gradient Compensation
records.reason: The abstract proposes block-wise LLM post-training quantization with refreshed gradient/Hessian estimates and trust-region scaling; experiments report better alignment to full precision than prior baselines. This targets inference memory and compute footprint.

records.title: Training-free Context-adaptive Attention for Efficient Long Context Modeling
records.reason: The abstract presents training-free sparse attention with offline sparsity calibration and lightweight online token selection, accelerating prefill and decoding while shrinking KV-cache memory. It reports 2.8× speedup and 61% less cache at 128K context.

records.title: Learning Query-Aware Budget-Tier Routing for Runtime Agent Memory
records.reason: The abstract introduces BudgetMem, a runtime agent-memory router selecting memory-processing tiers by query under cost/performance budgets, improving accuracy-cost frontiers. This is an inference-time memory/runtime efficiency technique.

records.title: HunyuanOCR-1.5: Making Lightweight OCR VLMs Faster and Better
records.reason: The abstract describes adapting DFlash to OCR VLM decoding, reporting 6.37× Transformer and 2.14× vLLM inference speedups for long structured outputs while preserving output distribution. Although OCR-specialized, it provides an explicit multimodal LLM inference acceleration method.

records.title: SmartCache: Two-Dimensional KV-Cache Similarity for Efficient Long-Context LLM Decoding
records.reason: The official HPCC 2025 program confirms this exact title and author list, but IEEE Xplore required JavaScript/robot verification and no primary abstract was retrieved. With only program metadata, retain as borderline pending method evidence.

records.title: HiRE: High Recall Approximate Top-k Estimation for Efficient LLM Inference
records.reason: The abstract proposes compressed predictors for identifying high-value FFN rows/columns and a multi-device approximate top-k operator, reporting 1.47× lower inference latency on TPUv5e with near-matching quality. This targets model-weight transfer and compute latency.

records.title: Instruction-Following Pruning for Large Language Models
records.reason: The abstract proposes instruction-conditioned dynamic structured pruning with a sparse mask predictor. It activates task-relevant parameters so a 3B active model can rival 9B performance on reported tasks, reducing deployed computation.

records.title: Integer Scale: A Free Lunch for Faster Fine-grained Quantization of LLMs
records.reason: The abstract introduces calibration-free post-training quantization support for fine-grained LLM quantization, reporting up to 1.85× speedup and larger end-to-end gains on Mixtral and Llama-3 with comparable accuracy. This targets inference quantization overhead and latency.
